coverage_scope: Production timings 96; diagnostics 32; forced-full references 32; public durable release recovery 3. Only initial campaign-001 exhausted its 120-second preparation limit; retained separately.

operational_limits.byte_axis: Unused string padding at fixed N/H/D/Q; actual canonical evidence bytes measured
operational_limits.cache: fresh process/store; OS file cache not flushed
operational_limits.isolation: All builds finish before timing; auxiliary process affinity excludes measurement CPU; record observed competing work; never stop unrelated user processes.
operational_limits.phase_contract: setup and prepared history excluded from cycle but measured separately; contiguous eight evaluate/commit transitions plus final evaluation; separately read, page, reopen/first evaluation, replay/recovery
operational_limits.protocol_amendment: Initial 120-second full-reference population-8192 preparation exhausted; preserve campaign-001 and repeat every case with 300-second operational limit before candidate evaluation. No semantic or product performance criterion changed.
operational_limits.retention: append-only attempts; no dropped repetitions; revised protocol is a new campaign; incomplete coverage cannot pass
